title: Allow read-only workflow audience POSTs by exact action
answers: Why does the workflow audience count never load during read-only impersonation?
Why does audience sizing return 403 impersonation_read_only?
How should a read-only POST bypass impersonation middleware?
body:
Symptom: Support staff impersonating in read-only mode cannot load a workflow audience count; sizing returns 403 impersonation_read_only.
Root cause: posthog/middleware.py:ImpersonationReadOnlyMiddleware rejects non-idempotent requests before endpoint permissions run; audience sizing uses POST because its filters are too large for a query string.
Fix pattern: Add a method-and-exact-action exception in posthog/middleware.py:READ_ONLY_IMPERSONATION_ALLOWLISTED_PATHS after establishing that the action only reads; the workflow audience regex accepts projects/environments, numeric IDs/@current, and an optional trailing slash.
Constraints: Never allow the whole hog_flows/ prefix: it also contains writing actions. Audience sizing may return a confirmation token, but run and batch_jobs must remain blocked so read-only impersonation cannot dispatch a send.
applies: Read-only impersonation failures for workflow audience sizing and narrowly scoped exceptions for read-only POST actions.
